Latest partial source has a successful release build only. Its scope/folding/target refinements have not rerun the Java121/metadata161/Kotlin21 checks, Rust tests, formatting or Clippy. Those JVM passes belong to archived dev-v2/dev-v3 sources/binaries only.

Oracle extras found two wrong authored expectations: a plain constructor parameter named Token does not shadow the class in a method annotation (accepted), and annotation element annotationType is accepted. Current lexical scope checks may reject the former; correct scope semantics only if work resumes.

Source annotation element names hashCode/toString are oracle-invalid; corresponding source declaration guards are not yet deliberately implemented or tested. Do not infer candidate rejection from the oracle report.

Kotlin annotation KClass/Class element reads have distinct logical and physical JVM return types. The classpath records logical KClass but ordinary member emission may cast raw Class to KClass without wrapping. Need actual Kotlin annotation ABI conversion through real Reflection runtime declarations or an explicit unsupported fence, including Class[]/KClass[] cases, before accepting such source reads.

Class literal extraction currently checks public flags and Kotlin visibility but does not have complete Java InnerClasses visibility provenance. Preserve or add a defensible explicit Java nested-class boundary; do not accept inaccessible classifiers through incomplete flags.

Recursive annotation/default scalar folding and AnnotationConstant integer-origin markers were added to preserve Int-to-Long context, based on a pinned oracle probe: literal arithmetic accepted, declared Int constants rejected. Final source has not revalidated all constexpr scopes, shadows, forward references, cycles and boundaries.

Array factories now require actual builtin metadata identity, compatible array descriptors and explicit generic arguments, and track duplicate empty varargs. These tightened paths have not rerun the candidate negative matrix. emptyArray and other valid constant forms need explicit support or an honest unsupported boundary.

Direct/mutual annotation cycles are intended invalid; array-mediated cycles are explicitly unsupported because specification/pin interpretation remains unresolved. New graph guards have not rerun the full negative matrix.

Default Kotlin PROPERTY target normalization and synthetic annotation methods were added; current source has not rerun those refinements. Constant-property/interface-companion/other unsupported placement combinations need precise classification and metadata checks.

Classpath annotation decoding now reads Kotlin constructor order/types/varargs and separate Kotlin targets, but full AnnotationDefault value validation, future metadata-version guards and malformed constant-pool tag tests remain necessary. Arbitrary passive meta-annotations must not silently admit compiler/plugin semantics.

Source generic/nonpublic/nested annotation declarations, Byte/Short/unsigned elements, complex KClass bounds, repeatable lowering, type-use/local/expression placements and runtime instantiation remain intended bounded unsupported contexts. Confirm all frontends reject them explicitly rather than unclassified errors.

The partial incorporates classliteral6v1 with v4 diagnostic deltas against its recorded constants-v5 base. Preserve newer accepted generic/sealed/array/visibility source during any eventual three-way integration; never whole-overwrite current master from this old provisional base.
